title: Property Spawn Location
body:
"Good way to spawn in a specific area on your property!"

The Property Spawn Location is an object that can be purchased from Illumine Designs. It allows the user to change where they spawn on their property.

Description

The Property Spawn Location is a gray rectangle with the classic spawn circle on its top face. Once placed, whenever a player respawns, they will respawn at the location of the Property Spawn Location rather than the center of their lot. This can be used to quickly return to one's property by resetting their character. Alternatively, one may choose to use a logic system with a Commander and an Interactor to effectively teleport oneself back to their property without needing to wait for a respawn.
